arStrings.szText:
{/if}{c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
Shapeshift into a Werewolf and howl furiously, {if:Mod.UpgradeB}Restoring {c_resource}[SF_0 * 100]{/c} of your Maximum Spirit{else}Healing you for {c_number}[SF_0 * 100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_0]){/c}{/if}.
Providing Critical Strike Chance to Companions and Allies
{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} increases Healing Received from all sources by {c_number}[SF_17 * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_18]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} instead restores {c_number}[SF_19]{/c} Spirit for every {c_number}[1|%|]{/c} of Life that would have been healed.

{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} to yourself and allies for {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} seconds and an additional {c_number}[SF_8*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to other Players for the duration. 
In addition, you deal {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_UPGRADEC_POISONING}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEC_DOT}{/c} seconds while {c_important}Blood Howl{/c} is active.

For {c_number}[SF_24]{/c} seconds after casting {c_important}Blood Howl{/c}, {if:Mod.UpgradeB}restore {c_resource}[SF_23 * 100]{/c} Spirit{else}heal for {c_number}[SF_23 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life{/if} each time you hit an enemy.

These bonuses are doubled on Critical Strikes.
{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} increases your Dodge Chance by {c_number}[SF_25 * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blood Howl{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[SF_29 * 100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blood Howl's{/c} base healing is increased by {c_number}[SF_7 * 100|%x|]{/c}.
